findings.text: the baseline_suite and after_suite command fields name tests/test_dispatch_spy.py, which exists at neither revision (git cat-file -e 40d23d9:tests/test_dispatch_spy.py refuses), while the logs those fields point at ran tests/test_dispatch_spawns_through_the_fleet.py; the gate evidence and counts stand, but the structured field a promotion reader and a re-runner reads disagrees with the log it names, and re-running it fails on the missing path.

worker_scratch_root() resolves through tempfile.gettempdir() and only its docstring asserts the root is node-local, so a dispatcher carrying a shared-storage TMPDIR places every run's scratch on GPFS — the leak section 6 exists to close — while reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:219 pins the same variable to /tmp for exactly that reason.

the exception fallbacks in _release_after_promotion and _remove_discarded_worktree (reckon/crew/promotion.py:5150) return dicts naming worktree_released, process_signalled and worktree_withheld but no scratch field, so a release that raises leaves the scratch directory in place with nothing in the record saying so, which is the one path where the rule the removal comment states does not hold.
